history.summary: IDENTITY AMBIGUOUS (verify): Ranchi has multiple temples listed as 'Shree Shyam Mandir' — one on Harmu Road at Garikhana (coordinates 23.37195, 85.312882; listed hours 5:00 AM-12:30 PM and 4:30 PM-9:30 PM), one at Agrasen Path, Upper Bazar, and one at Kumhartoli. This file documents the most widely reviewed one on Harmu Road, a temple of Shree Shyam (Khatu Shyam Ji, a form of Krishna) with an active congregation and daily worship. Its founding date is not published in any source found — UNVERIFIED.

name: Shree Shyam Mandir, Ranchi
town_description: Ranchi is the capital of Jharkhand, set on the Chota Nagpur Plateau at about 650 metres above sea level. Known as the 'City of Waterfalls' for the many falls around it, it blends tribal heritage, colonial-era landmarks and modern industry. It is the main pilgrimage base for the temples and festivals of the plateau region.

travel.airport: Birsa Munda Airport, Ranchi — about 8 km (verify)
travel.road: Harmu Road, central Ranchi; reachable by city bus, auto-rickshaw or taxi

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Phalguna Ekadashi is the main Shyam festival
visitor_information.opening_hours: 5:00 AM-12:30 PM and 4:30 PM-9:30 PM daily (Harmu Road listing); the Upper Bazar Shree Shyam Mandir lists different hours — confirm which temple before visiting (verify)
